mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'SALE' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'PURCHASE' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT f.name as fruit_name, f.unit, SUM(ti.quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(ti.total_price) as total_revenue FROM transaction_items ti JOIN fruits f ON ti.fruit_id = f.id JOIN transactions t ON ti.transaction_id = t.id WHERE t.type = 'SALE' AND t.status != 'CANCELLED' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.unit ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

SELECT c.name as customer_name, c.phone, COUNT(t.id) as transaction_count, SUM(t.total_amount) as total_amount FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id WHERE t.type = 'SALE' AND t.status != 'CANCELLED' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.phone ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.name as supplier_name, s.phone, COUNT(t.id) as transaction_count, SUM(t.total_amount) as total_amount FROM transactions t JOIN suppliers s ON t.supplier_id = s.id WHERE t.type = 'PURCHASE' AND t.status != 'CANCELLED' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.phone ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(transaction_date) as sale_date, SUM(total_amount) as total_sales, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE type = 'SALE' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(transaction_date) ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT f.name as fruit_name, f.unit, IFNULL(SUM(i.quantity), 0) as total_quantity, f.selling_price, CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(i.quantity), 0) = 0 THEN 'OUT_OF_STOCK' WHEN IFNULL(SUM(i.quantity), 0) <= MIN(i.low_stock_threshold) THEN 'LOW_STOCK' ELSE 'IN_STOCK' END as stock_status FROM fruits f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.id = i.fruit_id WHERE f.active = true GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.unit, f.selling_price ORDER BY f.name

SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'SALE' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND DATE(transaction_date) = CURDATE()) as today_sales, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'PURCHASE' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND DATE(transaction_date) = CURDATE()) as today_purchases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE status = 'PENDING') as pending_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE active = true) as total_customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suppliers WHERE active = true) as total_suppliers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fruits WHERE active = true) as total_fruits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE quantity <= low_stock_threshold) as low_stock_alerts
